next.reason: 1985 admits BLANK WHEN ZERO for any elementary item 'whose PICTURE is specified as numeric or numeric edited'; no 1985 rule bars the symbol S. §2023:13.18.8.3 SR1 narrows this to 'category numeric-edited or ... numeric without the picture symbol S', so PIC S9(4) BLANK WHEN ZERO, legal in 1985, is refused. §2023:13.16.3 SR11 keeps the elementary-only part. The usage requirement (§2023:13.18.8.3 SR2) answers 1985 SR2, not this rule. Both are compile-time rules.
